$ pack create --help
Usage: pack create [options] NAME [COMMENT]

Create an archive.

Arguments:
      NAME     Name of the archive.
      COMMENT  Comment of the archive.  default "none"

Global options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env PACK_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
[exit 0]

$ pack add --help
Usage: pack add [options] ARCHIVE FILES...

Add files to an archive.

Arguments:
      ARCHIVE  Archive that receives the files.
      FILES    Files to add, or - for the standard input.

Options:
  -l, --level int  Level of the compression.  default "6", env PACK_ADD_LEVEL, key add.level

Global options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env PACK_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
[exit 0]

$ pack create logs
create "logs" with the comment "none"
[exit 0]

$ pack create logs 'rotated daily'
create "logs" with the comment "rotated daily"
[exit 0]

$ pack create
pack: create: missing argument NAME
[exit 2]

$ pack create logs daily extra
pack: create: unexpected argument "extra"
[exit 2]

$ pack add logs app.log -l 9 db.log
add "app.log" to "logs" at level 9
add "db.log" to "logs" at level 9
[exit 0]

$ pack add logs
pack: add: missing argument FILES
[exit 2]

$ pack add logs -- -odd.log --level
add "-odd.log" to "logs" at level 6
add "--level" to "logs" at level 6
[exit 0]

$ pack add logs -
add "-" to "logs" at level 6
[exit 0]

$ pack list
list every file
[exit 0]

$ pack list '*.log' 'app-*'
list the files that match ["*.log" "app-*"]
[exit 0]

$ pack create logs >/dev/full
pack: main: write the result: transcript: no space left on device
[exit 1]
